content:
Marta Ruiz: Heads-up — running the midweek traffic replay tonight 00:30-02:30 PT. Primary goal: validate the regen fallback and KV cache warmup under sustained tail latency. Asking for quick checks and profiling help.
Kevin Chen: I can watch the perf dashboard and trace spans. What replay script and dataset are we using?
Marta Ruiz: Using k6 replay of last Friday's 2h window, dataset: s3://replays/2026-03-13/pri-hour.zip. Script is the lightweight flow (no user metadata).
Samir Patel: Can we start with a scaled-down dry-run at 00:15 to verify routing rules and fallback to smaller model variant? I don't want a surprise canary failover during peak.
Marta Ruiz: yes, dry-run 00:15 for 10m. Full run 00:30. Kevin — please verify canary policy: route to r1-variant when p95 > 250ms for 2min.
Kevin Chen: got it. I'll set a temporary dashboard tile for p95 and error-rate and add an annotation for the run.
Jessica Li: Quick ask for runtime folks: if latency regresses, can someone enable continuous profiler (async sampling) on the selected pool? CPU profiles + heap every 5m would be ideal.
Samir Patel: I can enable async profiling on the dedicated pool. Will collect 5m CPU + heap snapshots to s3:/profiles/midweek-1769500000/. Any special flags?
Marta Ruiz: enable with these env flags: `RUNTIME_PROFILER=cpu,heap` and `PROFILER_INTERVAL=300` — try single collector to avoid overhead.
Samir Patel: ✅ I'll run the rollout to a single node first.
k6-bot: Scheduled replay job created: job_id=kj-2026031769500000, dry_run_at=1769500500, full_run_at=1769501400.
devops-bot: Reminder: increase log retention for this window + set sampling rate to full for request logs.
Kevin Chen: For trace correlation, include header `X-Replay-Id: midweek-1769500000` in the replay generator. I'll filter traces by that.
Jessica Li: Also please record KV-cache hit ratios pre/during/post. I want to compare prefix warming impact.
Marta Ruiz: Good call. Add a quick script to sample KV stats every minute. Samir can you attach the sampling cron to the replay host?
Samir Patel: Will do. I'll push `scripts/kv-sample.sh` and run `watch -n 60 ./kv-sample.sh > /tmp/kv-midweek.log` on the generator host.
Kevin Chen: If we see a tail at >400ms, perform a controlled fallback: set routing to r2-quantized and throttle burst policy to 60%. I'll coordinate with infra.
Jessica Li: How long before we can get flamegraphs? If we need to debug GPU kernel stalls, I want to have them ready.
Samir Patel: Flamegraphs from CPU profiles should be available within ~10 minutes after collection; GPU side I'll capture `nvprof` spans only if we see GPU queueing. That's more intrusive.
Marta Ruiz: Plan summary: 00:15 dry-run 10m; 00:30 full 120m; profiling enabled (5m CPU/heap); KV sampling every 60s; traces tagged with X-Replay-Id. Kevin watches dashboard and will flip fallback rules if p95>250ms. Samir runs profiler and KV sampling; Jess on call for flamegraphs if needed.
Jessica Li: I'll be online and can grab logs and start flamegraph capture if traces point at kernels.
Kevin Chen: Small note — let's reduce k6 generator instance count for the dry run to 2, then scale to 8 for full-run to avoid stampeding caches.
Marta Ruiz: acknowledged. k6 command for the full run (for reference):
```
k6 run --vus 320 --duration 2h --out influxdb=http://metrics:8086 \
  --summary-export=results.json replay_script.js --env REPLAY_DATA=s3://replays/2026-03-13/pri-hour.zip \
  --tag replay_id=midweek-1769500000
```
Samir Patel: Copy that. I'll start the generator at 00:25 with scale-up script.
devops-bot: Alert rule created: replay-midweek-p95 > 300ms for 3m => #eng-runtime on-call.
Marta Ruiz: Thanks everyone. If any quick post-run notes, drop them here. After the run we'll run a short regression check against the smoke prompt set and upload perf diffs to the perf-triage board.
Kevin Chen: Will post perf snapshots and traces to the thread.
Jessica Li: I'll upload KV-sample and profiler outputs to s3 and link them here.
Samir Patel: Tests completed: dry-run OK. Full run started. Monitoring now.
Marta Ruiz: :thumbsup:
Kevin Chen: Seeing a small p95 blip at 00:52, investigating trace spans now.
Samir Patel: profiler snapshots show increased GC activity at 00:51-00:53, sending heap diffs to s3.
Jessica Li: KV hit ratio warmed from 12% to 72% over first 20m, looks like prefix caching working as expected.
Kevin Chen: p95 stabilized after fallback to r2-quantized at 00:55, no user-facing errors detected. Posting short summary to perf-triage.
Marta Ruiz: Excellent. Post-run checklist: upload run manifest, link traces, document any follow-ups. I'll open a follow-up ticket for investigating the GC spike.
Samir Patel: Added notes and attached profiler artifacts: s3://profiles/midweek-1769500000/
Jessica Li: KV logs: s3://metrics/kv-midweek-1769500000.log
Kevin Chen: Perf snapshots: s3://perf-dumps/midweek-1769500000/summary.json
Marta Ruiz: Great work team, closing thread after I create the follow-up ticket. :rocket:
